name: crypto
description: Dominio CRYPTOGRAPHY via FFI: hash (SHA-1/256/384/512, SHA-3, MD5, RIPEMD-160), HMAC, PBKDF2/HKDF, AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, password hash, checksum (CRC32, CRC32C, CRC16, CRC64, Adler-32, Fletcher-32), encoding hex/base64/base64url. Sorgenti canonici in gmbsuite/gmbcrypto, copia self-contained qui.

ffi.declareExample: DECLARE FUNCTION CRC32RAW LIB "gmbcrypto" ALIAS "ofx_crypto_crc32" (data() AS BYTE, n AS LONG) AS LONG

nativeRequirements.libcrypto: >=3.0 (OpenSSL 3; brew install openssl@3). Non e' un pacchetto del package manager: la lib e' linkata a runtime (ffi.link = -lcrypto).
